nonclaims: Yaw is not represented at point_mass_3dof and is reported NOT_APPLICABLE.
No attitude dynamics, individual motor allocation, rotor inflow, reaction torque, or physical moment balance is claimed.
claim.proves: An independent Hummingbird point-mass force model completes the translational altitude, hover-box, disturbance, contact, and shutdown objectives.

parent_native_mission.comparison_boundary: semantic objective comparison only; native and pseudo runtimes use different controllers, horizons, and sample rates, so trajectory/time deltas are not asserted
parent_native_mission.control_boundary: native packet is the rigid-body/direct-wrench parent evidence; pseudo packet remains aggregate thrust-vector response-law evidence and does not inherit motor allocation

landing_evidence.note: The rigid-body runtime records an explicit static-pad contact impulse, normal reaction, and post-contact settle segment; landing gear, tire, and ground-effect dynamics remain outside this claim.

parent_native_mission.mapping_boundary: The disturbance-recovery objective is new to the pseudo mission and has no equivalent in the legacy native packet; it is therefore reported as unmapped rather than as a disagreement.

parent_parity.claim_boundary: independent native hover translational parity only; not full mission qualification
